slides.title: Leave with one shared plan.
slides.headline: Leave with one shared plan.
notes: Check that the financial and operating targets reconcile across the 3-year, annual and quarterly plans.
Confirm every commitment and metric has an owner. Everything is on the board. Entering it in Metronome is homework.
Record the widget-based company metric and its definition. Keep the scoreboard accessible to the team.

panels.heading: Function Chart + KFFM
panels.support: Keep the maps, owners, handoffs and measures.

panels.heading: Purpose, values and ambition
panels.support: Capture the agreed purpose, values and BHAG.

panels.heading: 3HAG, 1HAG and QHAG
panels.support: Targets with owners, 3HAG capabilities, and priorities with a done-by date, a measure of success and an achieved-by date.

panels.heading: Individual commitments
panels.support: Each person’s critical number, priorities and professional development.

slides.title: Did we get what we came for?
slides.headline: Did we get what we came for?
notes: Read back the answers the team agreed on at the start.
For each one, ask for a show of hands: met, partly met or still open.
Still open is fine. Add each open answer to the homework with an owner and a date.
The sticky shows the coach’s answer for the session. Ask the team whether they achieved it, along with their own.

artwork.alt: A sticky note with the coach’s answer for the session: Team clarity and commitment.

slides.support: For each answer: met, partly met or still open?

slides.title: What is the homework?
slides.headline: What is the homework?
notes: The CEO and coach also prepare before the next session. It covers the team assessment and the Head of Company scorecard preparation and review. Confirm these privately with the CEO. Add any answers still open from the previous check, with owners.
Agree on an owner and completion date for each follow-through action. Confirm when the team will review completion.

In Metronome, enter the Core Purpose, Core Values, BHAG, 3HAG, 1HAG, QHAG and individual priorities. Each leader adds the priorities they own. Add the widget-based company metric, if defined. Enter the agreed functions and owners in Function Chart. Build the reporting relationships in Team View.
Finance leader: add the primary widgets to this year’s forecast.
Give every item an owner and a date (What, Owner, By When), as on the board’s Homework area. Review completion at the next agreed meeting.

panels.heading: Enter the plan
panels.support: The whole plan, and each leader’s critical number and priorities. Enter the agreed functions and owners in Function Chart. Build the reporting relationships in Team View.

panels.heading: Widgets in the forecast
panels.support: Add the primary widgets to this year’s forecast.

panels.heading: Messages and huddles
panels.support: Share the 3 messages with your team the day after. Run the first daily huddle.

panels.heading: Prepare
panels.support: Read The 3HAG Way. Complete the Q1 prep survey and share it.
